cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Provisional, as you say. I'll tell the caterer it's yes. Just agree before I call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Provisional means not confirmed. We haven't counted the guests.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, a provisional yes. We can fill in the number afterwards; I just need your yes now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We haven't even seen the quote.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll open it while you agree. You can start with yes, and I'll have the figures ready for the rest of the conversation.

reason: Replace detachable certainty with a specific copied misunderstanding that changes how A delays, seeks apology or assent, transfers responsibility, or retrieves a lost plan.
